title: Document or harden the inaccessible-PID reuse residual in Windows cleanup probes
outcome: The rare PID-reuse/access-denied case has an explicit conservative contract and does not silently weaken cleanup proof.
acceptance: Document or deterministically model a departed PID reused by a process the owner cannot open; preserve unresolved for genuinely unobservable owned members.

Make any departed-PID test control accurately distinguish the expected departed/foreign classification from an inaccessible reused identity, without retries, swallowed errors or weakening held-descendant/unrelated-process checks.
